we present a novel framework, called Fine Grained Action Repeation (FiGAR) for reinforcement learning algorithms that allows the agents to learn to repeat actions.

(1) FiGAR is a framework for fine grained action repetition, (2) it enables an agent to decide the time scale of action repetition, (3) FiGAR can be used in conjunction with any reinforcement learning algorithm and is not restricted to a specific one, (4) FiGAR achieves significant performance gains in a variety of environments and tasks, and (5) FiGAR enables the agent to learn more complex behavioral patterns
